routes.title: Routes
routes.description: One route per line as ORIGIN-DESTINATION, using city names as Traveloka knows them, for example Jakarta-Bandung. Accepted separators: -, ->, > or the word 'to'.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Single-route alternative to the Routes list: departure city, terminal or landmark.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Single-route alternative to the Routes list: arrival city, terminal or landmark.

departureDate.title: First departure date
departureDate.description: First travel date to check, in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to seven days from today.

daysToMonitor.title: Consecutive days
daysToMonitor.description: How many consecutive travel dates to check per route, starting from the first departure date. One search per route per day.

adults.title: Passengers
adults.description: Adult passengers. Affects which inventory Traveloka shows and the seat counts returned.

maxDeparturesPerSearch.title: Max departures per search
maxDeparturesPerSearch.description: Cap on departures kept per route per date. Traveloka expands every pickup point by drop-off point combination, so one busy city pair can return several thousand rows; 200 is usually plenty.

dedupeBy.title: De-duplicate by
dedupeBy.description: The same trip is listed once per pickup point. 'Trip' keeps one row per physical departure and is what you normally want; 'None' keeps every boarding option; 'Operator' keeps one row per operator, time and class.
enumTitles: One row per operator and time

productTypes.title: Vehicle types
productTypes.description: Keep only these product types, for example BUS or SHUTTLE. Leave empty for both.

includeDepartures.title: Include individual departures
includeDepartures.description: Emit one DEPARTURE row per trip with operator, fare, times, pickup and drop-off points and facilities.
includeDepartures.groupDescription: Filter the dataset on recordType to separate departures from route summaries.

includeRouteSummary.title: Include a route summary
includeRouteSummary.description: Emit one ROUTE_SUMMARY row per route and date with fare range, operator count and a per-operator breakdown.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Traveloka locale, which drives the language of facility and point labels.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for all fares in the output.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to pause between searches. Bus responses are large, so keep this above half a second on long runs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Residential is the default: Traveloka's AWS WAF answers a captcha to the session bootstrap on most Apify datacenter IPs. If you pick a datacenter group, the actor tries it first and falls back to residential sessions when it is challenged.
